CustomField.description: The settlement rhythm as a final number of months — our smallest unit. The middleware translates the SAP rhythm (count + unit, e.g. 01Q) into months: 01M → 1, 01Q/01V → 3, 01H → 6, 01J → 12, 02M → 2 etc. [Sources: K-4 2026-08-11]
